Robert D. Anderson & the Legacy of Cthulhu

name: Robert D. Anderson & the Legacy of Cthulhu
storyline: Robert D. Anderson, a New York private investigator and last descendant of an old aristocratic family, becomes involved in a mysterious case that leads him to investigate his family's past and a connection to the occult. His investigation takes him to Germany during the era of the Third Reich, where he becomes entangled with the secretive Order of the Black Sun and its supernatural activities. The story unfolds across 15 chapters combining investigation, exploration, puzzles, combat, filmed sequences, and Lovecraftian horror.
summary: Anderson & the Legacy of Cthulhu is a playable Horror Novel containing shooter and adventure elements. It takes the Protagonist Robert D. Anderson, last descendant of a counts dynasty, from New York to Germany around 1940, where he finds himself in the middle of the starting World War. Following his obscure and dire family history, he discovers a huge underground system of cages and caverns beneath his ancestors' castle. There the legendary Order of the black sun jeopardises live as it exists with dark blasphemous rituals..
